question.zh: 我记得上周和小丽提过一个会，但想不起来具体是什么了。
question.en: I remember mentioning a meeting with Xiaoli last week. What was it about?

answer.zh: 是社区读书会的筹备会。你们约了周五下午 3 点线上讨论，主要确认活动流程和场地。
answer.en: It was the planning meeting for the community reading club. You agreed to meet online on Friday at 3 pm to discuss the agenda and venue.

source.zh: 和小丽的讨论 · 上周

question.zh: 每周一上午 9 点，提醒我把会议材料发给小丽。
question.en: Every Monday at 9 am, remind me to send the meeting materials to Xiaoli.

answer.zh: 安排好了。每周一上午 9 点，我会在工作台提醒你把材料发给小丽。
answer.en: Scheduled. Every Monday at 9 am, I will remind you in the workspace to send the materials to Xiaoli.

question.zh: 这份合作协议我不想上传云端，帮我整理一下需要确认的条款。
question.en: I do not want to upload this collaboration agreement to the cloud. Help me identify the terms I need to confirm.

answer.zh: 可以在本地一起梳理：交付时间、费用结算、修改范围，以及终止合作时的处理方式。
answer.en: We can work through it locally: delivery dates, payment terms, revision scope and what happens if the collaboration ends.

text.zh: 小李，在上海工作，研究生学习人机交互。
text.en: Li works in Shanghai and studied human-computer interaction in graduate school.

text.zh: 喜欢先看三条重点，再决定是否展开细节。
text.en: Prefers three key points first, then expands the details when needed.

text.zh: 正在和小丽筹备社区读书会，先确认场地与活动流程。
text.en: Planning a community reading club with Xiaoli, starting with the venue and agenda.

text.zh: 周五下午 3 点，与小丽线上讨论读书会筹备。
text.en: Friday at 3 pm: an online planning meeting with Xiaoli.
Remind me to send meeting materials
